title: Predicting “priority” from “subject,body”
licence: Multilingual Customer Support Tickets. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the creator’s current Hugging Face release). Commercial use: no. Non-commercial: experiments only. Don’t assume the current version permits training a model for a product that’s sold. The tickets are synthetic, and the versions share thousands of tickets, so never pool them.
setup: 13,178 texts, 5 labels, 5-fold stratified cross-validation. Character n-grams work across languages without a tokenizer.
decision: Best: characters (tf-idf) + logistic regression, balanced accuracy 92% against 20% for always guessing the most common label. The data’s licence doesn’t allow commercial use, so no model is saved: this measures what’s possible, nothing more.
notes: 13,178 rows in the file; nothing removed; 13,178 measured.
By language (characters (tf-idf) + logistic regression): de 92% of 13,178.
